summary: rwc-client preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads a Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun (release bun-v1.3.13) to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a bundled 727KB sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a heavily obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle using a rotating string-array (`n7gIxM=[...]`, decoder `WV8StW`) and hex-mangled identifiers, with no readable code path. The file name `math_init` does not correspond to any advertised functionality of a Vue-based rich-web-chat client, and the package has no legitimate need for a second JavaScript runtime at install time. The dist bundles (`dist/lib/richWebChat.common.14.js`, `dist/lib/richWebChat.umd.14.js`) additionally contain `ping` and HTTP GET primitives. Fetching an alternate runtime specifically to execute an obfuscated payload at install time is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: the Bun runtime bypasses Node-focused analyzers, and the actual behavior of the payload is hidden behind both the obfuscation and the alternate interpreter.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
